title: Purification of Mouse Pancreatic Islets using Histopaque Gradient Centrifugation
author: Nancy Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u7ueznw
materials: Solution Prep - 1X Hanks Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) - Sigma H6136
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Measure out 900ml of room temperature H 2 O 900 mL, MiliQ water
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating While gently stirring the water, add the powdered medium. Stir until dissolved. DO NOT HEAT.
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Rinse original vial with water to remove traces and add to above.
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Add 0.35g sodium bicarbonate and stir until dissolved. 0.35 g, Sodium Bicarbonate
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Adjust pH to 7.4
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Bring solution to 1L
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Add 4ml of 30% BSA (equitech bio, inc 160928-0262) to the prepared 1X HBSS
Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Store at 4°C 4 °C

Re-suspend pellet in 20ml of 1X HBSS+BSA. Pour re-suspended pellet through #60 screen (cell dissociation sieve, Sigma CD1-1KT) that has been rinsed with coating. Using a 30ml syringe filled with 1X HBSS+BSA and 18G needle rinse screen (use about 20ml). Return islets to 50ml tube and rinse the beaker with the remaining 10ml of 1X HBSS+BSA, add it to the tube.

Solution Prep - 1X Hanks' Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) + BSA - Sigma H6136 and Coating Take 34ml of the prepared 1X HBSS and add 6ml of 30% BSA (equitech bio, inc 160928-0262) in a 50ml falcon tube. This is to be used for coating.
Re-suspend the pellet with 5ml of Histopaque 1077 (Sigma 1077-1 500ml) with pipette that has been rinsed with coating. Add another 5ml of Histopaque and mix using coated pipette.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse Islet Culture Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the culture media by adding FBS and Pen/Strep to a bottle of RPMI and store at 4°C.

steps.title: Initial Gradient Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the Histopaque gradient tube following the completion of the pancreas digest.

substeps.instruction: Shake a 50ml falcon tube 30 times.

steps.title: Perform Initial Wash Cycles
steps.instruction: Perform a series of centrifugation and wash steps to clean the sample.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 339 g at 4°C.
Remove supernatant.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 339 g at 4°C.
Remove supernatant, add 10ml 1X HBSS+BSA, re-suspend pellet, and bring total volume to 50ml with 1X HBSS+BSA.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 339 g at 4°C.
Remove supernatant, add 10ml 1X HBSS+BSA, re-suspend pellet, and bring total volume to 50ml with 1X HBSS+BSA.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 339 g at 4°C.

steps.title: Clean and Prepare Tube
steps.instruction: Remove remaining supernatant and clean the tube interior while keeping the pellet on ice.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant.
Leave tube upside down on a paper towel to drip dry for 30 seconds.
Wipe the interior of the tube with a Kimwipe using long forceps, ensuring the pellet is not touched.
Leave tubes upright on ice.

steps.title: Layer Media and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Carefully layer the media and centrifuge to separate the islets.

substeps.instruction: Lay the tube at an angle on ice and gradually add 10ml of Mouse Media, ensuring the two mediums do not mix.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at 339 g at 4°C with the brake turned off.
Use the slowest rate of speed for both acceleration and deceleration if the centrifuge has these settings.

steps.title: Recover and Wash Islets
steps.instruction: Collect the islet-containing layers and perform a final wash.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (both layers) into a new single 50ml falcon tube.
Bring the volume up to 50ml with 1X HBSS+BSA.
Keep tubes containing the pellet on ice (if islets are not in the supernatant, they may be recovered from the pellet by hand picking in Mouse Islet Media).
Centrifuge for 3 minutes at 339 g at 4°C.

steps.title: Final Islet Recovery and Incubation
steps.instruction: Finalize the islet purification and store them for use.

substeps.instruction: Decant the supernatant.
Re-suspend the pellet in 10 ml of Mouse Media.
Bring the volume up to 50ml by adding 1X HBSS+BSA to the falcon tube.
Hand pick islets if desired or necessary.
Incubate islets in Mouse Islet Media at 37°C with 5% CO2 until ready for use.
